top_gear_ratio.notes: Top (last forward) gear 0.653 per the official Spain 12/2020 and Germany 09/19/2023 and 02/04/2026 technical-data sheets.

gear_ratios.notes: Forward ratios 3.500 / 2.087 / 1.343 / 0.940 / 0.974 / 0.780 / 0.653 per the official Germany 09/19/2023 and 02/04/2026 technical-data sheets (the Spain 12/2020 sheet prints 4th 0.933 and 6th 0.778, all other gears the same).

final_drive_front.notes: The official sheets print two gearbox output final drives, 4.800 (1-2) and 3.429 (2-3), not front and rear axle ratios. Only one assignment of the forward ratios 3.500 / 2.087 / 1.343 / 0.940 / 0.974 / 0.780 / 0.653 keeps the overall ratios falling gear by gear: 1st-4th on 4.800 (4th 0.940 x 4.800 = 4.512) and 5th-7th on 3.429 (5th 0.974 x 3.429 = 3.340, 6th 2.675, 7th 0.653 x 3.429 = 2.239; 7th on 4.800 would give 3.134). So 3.429 is the final drive behind the top gear and is stored as final_drive_front; 4.800 drives only lower gears.

verification_notes.note: Facelifted Q2 35 TFSI 110 kW S tronic: the official Spain 12/2020, Germany 09/19/2023 and Germany 02/04/2026 sheets give the same final drives 4.800 / 3.429 and top gear 0.653. ADAC lists it from 10/2020 to 04/2026, so the row covers 2021-2026.
